data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Unfortunately the delivery service you…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a80bec8059c7ba453caa5ba)
Unfortunately the delivery service you use on small- mid size rugs, which is FedEx sits on the product for days before delivering. Promise after promise and consistent date changes. Their service is a huge fail as this is not a 1 off. I found this service terrible for years now. So no I don’t have my product yet and idk when I will get it. It’s 19 miles from my house just sitting.

August 10, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 17, 2026

Hi Debbie,

We’re sorry to hear about the repeated delivery delays and understand how frustrating it is to see your package sitting nearby without being delivered. We appreciate you sharing this feedback regarding our third-party carrier.

We do see that your 8x10 rug has now been delivered, and we hope you’re happy with the rug itself. Thank you for your patience while this was being resolved.
